description: Epicenter’s Folders window manages the folders the epicenter CLI syncs: it lists them, sets one up through the Rust-owned picker, a clone, or an accepted epicenter://init request, syncs, forgets, and shares one, and opens a synced folder's files, each as one CLI call. It also opens bundled apps on their defaults or a picked folder, hosted sites, and Settings. It is bound to no folder and is served on the local epicenter-app scheme.
